regulations.enforcement_body: City of Grand Junction Community Development
regulations.notes: Grand Junction requires a separate STR permit for each rental unit. Permits are valid for one year and require annual renewal. Both principal dwelling units and ADUs can obtain an STR permit. The city adopted Ordinance 5163 and later amendments to regulate STRs. Verify current fee schedule at gjcity.org.
